title.narrative: MOMENTUM 2C - Advancing Collaboration and Communicationon Evidence and Learning (ACCEL) for MOMENTUM

description.narrative: The purpose of MOMENTUM 2C: Advancing Collaboration and Communication on Evidence and Learning (ACCEL) for MOMENTUM, is to focus on monitoring and evaluation (M&E), and knowledge management and translation of learning across the entire portfolio of MOMENTUM awards.
